title: Queen Camilla Says It Was ‘Difficult’ to Keep Charles’s Cancer a Secret
summary_full: “I was just longing to let it out,” Camilla said in rare public comments about the king’s 2024 diagnosis, which was not immediately revealed. “But obviously I couldn’t.”
